name: bds_session_seed
description: Foundations 6.3 [choice]: the file-local generator is seeded with derive(K) = S XOR K, moved by XOR 1 when it would be 0 or 0xFFFFFFFF; K is the original's clock XOR constant. Expected states from an independent Python model of derive(). Building development simulator (K = 0x0C09C0B8): BdsProcess::from_session gives 0x12345678 -> 0x1E3D96C0 (an arbitrary session); 0x00000000 -> 0x0C09C0B8 (session 0 = the original's seed at clock value 0); 0x0C09C0B8 -> 0x00000001 (S = K: S XOR K = 0 is moved to 1); 0xF3F63F47 -> 0xFFFFFFFE (S = NOT K: 0xFFFFFFFF is moved to 0xFFFFFFFE).
